summary: Completed comprehensive backend API testing for ANELEC Groupe / Suivi TCE theme persistence fix. Tested all 7 auth and admin/appearance endpoints. The fix successfully prevents HTTP 500 errors on login when theme columns are missing from the database. All endpoints return correct status codes and data structures.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials (demo@suivi-tce.fr / demo1234) returns HTTP 200 with user object containing theme object (companyDefault, allowOverride, userPref, resolved) and accessToken
POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns HTTP 401 with code INVALID_CREDENTIALS (not HTTP 500) - confirms the bug fix is working
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns HTTP 200 with complete user object including theme information
PATCH /api/auth/me/theme with {"theme":"atlas"} returns HTTP 200 and updates theme.userPref to 'atlas' and theme.resolved to 'atlas'
PATCH /api/auth/me/theme with {"theme":"reset"} returns HTTP 200 and resets theme.userPref to null (falls back to company default)
GET /api/admin/appearance with Bearer token returns HTTP 200 with defaultTheme, allowThemeOverride, and availableThemes (7 themes)
PATCH /api/admin/appearance with {"defaultTheme":"craft"} returns HTTP 200 and successfully updates company default theme
notes: The theme persistence fix in /app/server/lib/userSelect.ts is working correctly
The resilient user selection gracefully handles missing theme columns (P2022 errors)
Login no longer returns HTTP 500 when theme columns are absent from the database
All auth endpoints properly return theme objects with default values when columns are missing
Theme personalization endpoints work correctly for both setting and resetting user preferences
Admin appearance endpoints successfully manage company-wide theme defaults and override permissions
The fix maintains backward compatibility - works whether or not theme columns exist in the database
All 7 test cases passed with 100% success rate
Test credentials used: demo@suivi-tce.fr / demo1234 (ADMIN role)
